- **Jellyfish heal wounds in minutes** – [75 points, 16 comments](https://www.mbl.edu/news/jellyfish-can-heal-wounds-minutes-scientists-want-their-secrets); the top story by engagement, highlighting marine biology's potential for medical inspiration.
- **Drone Autonomy Crash Course** – [25 points, 2 comments](https://www.cggonzalez.com/blog/index.html); a practical resource for hobbyists and engineers.

**Signal:** The pardon story could revive the right-to-repair debate; jellyfish healing might spur biotech research interest.

足球.zh: 世界杯淘汰赛阶段昨夜今晨再战两场：法国1-0艰难击败巴拉圭，姆巴佩点射制胜，但巴拉圭的“黑暗艺术”引发广泛批评（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cn4dpd11v1eo)）；葡萄牙2-1绝杀克罗地亚，C罗点球破门，拉莫斯补时建功（[虎扑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9oV0p4ODBtOENMUUphRk9LX2g1Y0dYd3lpODQzYkQ4OTE2QTIwcW85OFN5elZUa2lHSXJ6TTlFeDdfS2hyVDlEYVBxYUdqd1lBWXBVSXVkazlYbmRUcDk1MGdJcWpTSk85Wm9nT25ZdHB5UQ)）。摩洛哥3-0完胜加拿大，延续34场不败，成为争冠黑马（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cy4e22gqe50o)）。英格兰即将对阵墨西哥，主帅图赫尔表示球迷友好（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c8r2827pyxlo)），但里斯·詹姆斯训练缺席成疑（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8jpjx1dkvo)）。阿兰·希勒分析认为英格兰不会畏惧阿兹台克球场（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gy0l7x25wo)）。世界杯格局逐渐清晰：法葡摩加上半区强手如林，英格兰若过关将与葡萄牙狭路相逢。
足球.en:
The World Cup Round of 16 delivered two contrasting narratives: France's gritty victory over Paraguay despite 'dark arts' tactics, and Portugal's narrow win over Croatia with late drama. England faces a last-16 test against Mexico with Reece James doubtful, while Morocco's 34-match unbeaten run makes them emerging contenders. The quarter-final slate is now set for high-stakes clashes.

- **France 1-0 Paraguay**: Kylian Mbappé's 70th-minute penalty broke a stubborn Paraguay side that used time-wasting and tactical fouls. France will now face an in-form Morocco. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cn4dpd11v1eo), [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/paraguay-vs-france/report/549855))
- **Portugal 2-1 Croatia**: Cristiano Ronaldo scored from the spot and Goncalo Ramos struck late to send Portugal through. Chinese fan communities on Hupu were highly engaged with the match. ([虎扑社区动态](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9oV0p4ODBtOENMUUphRk9LX2g1Y0dYd3lpODQzYkQ4OTE2QTIwcW85OFN5elZUa2lHSXJ6TTlFeDdfS2hyVDlEYVBxYUdqd1lBWXBVSXVkazlYbmRUcDk1MGdJcWpTSk85Wm9nT25ZdHB5UQ))
- **England team news**: Reece James missed training but Jarell Quansah is fit. Thomas Tuchel praised the Mexico fans' respect, while Alan Shearer forecast England would not be intimidated by the Azteca. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8jpjx1dkvo), [Shearer](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gy0l7x25wo))
- **Morocco's unbeaten streak**: The Atlas Bears beat Canada to reach the quarter-finals, now unbeaten in 34 matches and no longer seen as a fairytale. Their clash with France will be a defensive vs attacking test. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cy4e22gqe50o))

The football world now turns to England vs Mexico and the impending France-Morocco quarter-final, with narratives of discipline, resilience, and rising underdogs.

虎扑社区动态.zh: 虎扑社区今日焦点集中在电竞领域：BLG在英雄联盟赛事中击败T1，Knight当选虎扑最佳选手（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1oQndiTk9YMDhNNWR1VlRjQm9XYmNRc2gxNUVocUNzZEk5dm1aU09YcHUwRW1hZFdqRERCYXBzeEFPUjZ5T0hUZ3NNcWNpbXhieVdWUUg0UThkMzFscm5DaVpqNA)），Bin与Doran的发挥对比引发用户投票（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9fUm1Pb1RnVjVYVkZnSzgyOUFmamo1SlhFaXRTdExPTmR2UzNScTF4Y3haOElYMGlxZkFyeS0zSjc4clhwV0VlVzhfeDZ5aGFKMWxfZnVhanRUX2h3Z0ZqOTdpSQ)）。此外，虎扑上线了选秀大会球员追踪页面，吸引球迷参与互动（[MSN](https://news.google.)）。用户投稿和评分活跃，显示社区电竞讨论热度极高。世界杯葡萄牙绝杀等足球新闻也在虎扑引发讨论，但电竞内容占据主流。
虎扑社区动态.en:
Hupu community activity surged around BLG's dominant League of Legends victory over T1, with users rating players and debating the top lane matchup. Additionally, the site launched a draft player tracker for NBA-style draft enthusiasts, while a single football goal update from the Morocco game also garnered attention. The platform continues to blend esports and traditional sports engagement.

- **BLG beats T1 in LoL – Knight named MVP**: The Chinese team swept T1 with Knight earning the highest Hupu rating. Fans flooded the platform with posts praising the mid-laner's 'nuclear tank-assassin mage' performance. ([Hupu MVP](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1oQndiTk9YMDhNNWR1VlRjQm9XYmNRc2gxNUVocUNzZEk5dm1aU09YcHUwRW1hZFdqRERCYXBzeEFPUjZ5T0hUZ3NNcWNpbXhieVdWUUg0UThkMzFscm5DaVpqNA), [Fan post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5peDFtT003QWlFWXRkN0FIdnJVWG9jOVdpcE9tYVduVWVXY243UGNMUzBGNzdLaHBlLXFLZUo0aEdLakRDSWdlVWJ5cGh2YnhUM0Jfd1FaOW82Z2tUZWhHSHlyUQ))
- **Bin vs Doran debate**: Pre-match banter culminated in a community poll asking which top laner performed better. The discussion reflects Hupu's focus on head-to-head comparisons. ([Hupu poll](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9fUm1Pb1RnVjVYVkZnSzgyOUFmamo1SlhFaXRTdExPTmR2UzNScTF4Y3haOElYMGlxZkFyeS0zSjc4clhwV0VlVzhfeDZ5aGFKMWxfZnVhanRUX2h3Z0ZqOTdpSQ))
- **Draft player tracker launched**: Hupu introduced a page to track the upcoming draft, inviting fans to speculate on which player their favorite team should select. This gamified feature boosts offseason engagement. ([MSN/Hupu](https://news.google.))
- **Morocco World Cup goal update**: A short clip of Rahimi's low shot making it 3-0 against Canada also trended, showing Hupu's reach beyond esports. ([QQ/Hupu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTFBzMngwcDY4OW5kNzd3SVFHQVpWSGNVcE5EblZBajdkZlBNeDVMTVRVejVnYU0yNGQxNHlBc0NSdm9aSmZaT1FYS3NPeDRhUmxLamRVaG5ZOA))

With BLG's victory dominating conversation, Hupu's community is now looking ahead to the next round of League of Legends playoffs and the upcoming NBA draft speculation, keeping engagement high across both esports and traditional sports.

篮球.zh: CBA休赛期话题持续发酵。媒体人指出，中国男篮选帅应优先考虑了解CBA体系的外教（[新浪体育](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPLXVRak5qN0NpRTZXOWV3LTdSbmNzYzhQV3NHNThZZjdXZ2NrSjhNb2dLdzAxSFFnLW04MWRpeFB5VVl0SlUydXZ4SFJEajRaSFl4NjZRQ09vMVBRVFBnVkxrS0lJZl9SOVd4eXdnVWRrS2lWcjRhcGNPODhTcDRMbXdLQm8)），同时透露对归化球员的动力不足，更希望华裔球员回归（[新浪体育](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPZlM1VXNzdTI4b0Z5TmpTQ2dDaVFGZE1sZzVwQldpSTNRMUtBNG1fRmFzMmcwQXdqVVdYTjJBeDI2dTRKQzhFQ2hBY0Y4Y0NFdExQX0pLd0ZSSjlmRzgzalhPeWtDS0Via1l1bS1JSnBVWC1WMXBHNHZQZi1Ca0VLRERyVDE)）。另有媒体人建议CBA规定只能签大外援，以倒逼本土后卫和小前锋成长（[新浪体育](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQY25Wby1xRVQ2NnNJR3lOWHJudHZYT0NTcVFjREFQVzNRTXBEN3lmOTdtX0ZkZTdsWFV1Tlp3N3dHM2xEQlBNZkVuM3NKVUVTbVhiODVmdk56VFVYLTBLMUUtaUQxeElvaVEzNG95aElsSDMwc2dzVHgzOFhaRHpZQk9FZGo)）。此外，2026 FIBA 3x3安徽利辛公开赛将于7月11日开赛（[直播吧](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE12MFJSd1RkQWlVcFBsaEFURmVUdUlWWVNjdmdfemtBcy1OUURqQ2tFV0JsTzFSaW8yTXdFV0F1ZUQyNmRTYnd3d2s1WlcxaFAyOXVmZlkxOHFXczhTbW92dHczZFBQN05sMUxNaTlVbw)）。整体来看，中国篮球界正就发展方向展开务实讨论，从选帅到外援政策再到归化，态度趋于保守和内部挖潜。
篮球.en:
Chinese basketball circles are debating substantive reforms: calls to mandate only big foreign players in the CBA to develop domestic guards, and skepticism toward naturalization policies. Meanwhile, a FIBA 3x3 tournament in Anhui was announced. The discourse reflects a sport seeking structural evolution ahead of the next Olympic cycle.

- **CBA foreign policy debate**: Media pundits argued that limiting imports to centers would force Chinese guards and forwards to improve playmaking. The discussion is driven by China's recent international struggles. ([Sina Sports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQY25Wby1xRVQ2NnNJR3lOWHJudHZYT0NTcVFjREFQVzNRTXBEN3lmOTdtX0ZkZTdsWFV1Tlp3N3dHM2xEQlBNZkVuM3NKVUVTbVhiODVmdk56VFVYLTBLMUUtaUQxeElvaVEzNG95aElsSDMwc2dzVHgzOFhaRHpZQk9FZGo))
- **Naturalization reluctance**: Another pundit said the Chinese basketball federation lacks motivation to naturalize foreign players, preferring to wait for Chinese-heritage players to return. This contrasts with other Asian nations' aggressive naturalization strategies. ([Sina Sports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPZlM1VXNzdTI4b0Z5TmpTQ2dDaVFGZE1sZzVwQldpSTNRMUtBNG1fRmFzMmcwQXdqVVdYTjJBeDI2dTRKQzhFQ2hBY0Y4Y0NFdExQX0pLd0ZSSjlmRzgzalhPeWtDS0Via1l1bS1JSnBVWC1WMXBHNHZQZi1Ca0VLRERyVDE))
- **FIBA 3x3 tournament in Anhui**: The '博冠体育杯' will kick off July 11 in Lixin County, highlighting grassroots basketball development. ([直播吧](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE12MFJSd1RkQWlVcFBsaEFURmVUdUlWWVNjdmdfemtBcy1OUURqQ2tFV0JsTzFSaW8yTXdFV0F1ZUQyNmRTYnd3d2s1WlcxaFAyOXVmZlkxOHFXczhTbW92dHczZFBQN05sMUxNaTlVbw))
- **Titan Sports column on CBA**: A feature in Titan Sports Weekly discussed the state of the league, likely covering draft prospects and team strategies. ([Sina Sports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxPUG40MlBZU21MVjNuTU9DaVRQaTAyaEp1OHM2M29mVkZNT0w0OG5HT0xRa0pIY1ZMa1dLYXZHbG1PSnhYV0RSSDB1MGlab2Q1ZFY2RVk3Q05lZmRQWEJEeWZFTkhGaEdMVC0tZXM3LUg2dm9fQkplemp0dWFRbjI3UnBCSTRrdVVWc2RrYjNsdkh6S0NNSHM0))

The CBA off-season is becoming a battle of ideas on how best to rebuild Chinese basketball, with the 3x3 tournament offering a glimpse of on-the-ground development.

羽毛球.zh: 丹麦公开赛上，印尼男双组合阿尔菲安/阿迪安托继续高歌猛进，目标是不止于第四冠（[BWF](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxPdWZtMkphVlN3b0o1Ulh6VHJhY0hpR1pCdnB4ZGFidG1VX1ZBejI0dlhEeGd5VG5UUW5VUXZoRU1Hbkt0MVBqQ1FPak5IYTRFU3p4NzZSQjc5ODdvLW9YZkJsRzBGM09XZm9tZEFadVhBWDhLOUI5UUxQeEI2NTBlMHBXY1pRMk1xOUl3S2U1cEg1WFp2UnRyVjNCRmVZeWtYa21Ud2JtY2NqR0tjN2FoUjlB)）。这对组合近期状态火爆，若能在本站夺冠将巩固世界排名。目前丹麦公开赛处于中段，后续对手实力逐渐增强，考验他们的稳定性。
羽毛球.en:
The BWF Denmark Open draws near, with Indonesia's top men's doubles pair, Alfian/Ardianto, seeking a fifth title. Their consistency positions them as strong contenders for the year-end World Tour Finals. The event will test their form against a field of rising challengers.

- **Alfian/Ardianto eye fifth Denmark Open crown**: The Indonesian duo, already four-time winners, are aiming to extend their remarkable run at the Super 750 event. Their partnership remains one of the most stable in world badminton. ([BWF World Tour](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxPdWZtMkphVlN3b0o1Ulh6VHJhY0hpR1pCdnB4ZGFidG1VX1ZBejI0dlhEeGd5VG5UUW5VUXZoRU1Hbkt0MVBqQ1FPak5IYTRFU3p4NzZSQjc5ODdvLW9YZkJsRzBGM09XZm9tZEFadVhBWDhLOUI5UUxQeEI2NTBlMHBXY1pRMk1xOUl3S2U1cEg1WFp2UnRyVjNCRmVZeWtYa21Ud2JtY2NqR0tjN2FoUjlB))
- **Implications for the World Tour Finals**: Every point in the Denmark Open matters for qualification. Alfian/Ardianto currently lead the Race to Guangzhou standings and a strong performance could cement their place. ([same source])
- **Limited other news**: No major upsets or transfers were reported in the last 24 hours in the badminton world, making this the standout story.

The Denmark Open will be a key indicator of whether Alfian/Ardianto can maintain their dominance as the season progresses toward the Finals.

欧美.zh: 昨日欧美娱乐圈被三件事分割：特朗普国庆演讲的政治罗生门、Taylor Swift婚礼的极致私人品牌运营、以及Oasis纪录片与Beyoncé新单曲的经典IP再激活。特朗普在讲话中致敬老兵与宇航员，同时攻击共产主义，被[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/trump-speech-july-4-weather-evacuation-1236974274/)列为“冲突”标签；Swift的婚礼细节——包括Adam Sandler原创歌、定制手帕——将私事变为全民话题，其姨妈的泪目描述被[THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/lifestyle-news/taylor-swift-travis-kelce-wedding-blank-space-hankies-1236637926/)完整记录。Beyoncé的回归用一首歌为《B'Day》重发售锚定日期，音乐行业“重发经济”热度不减。此外，Russell T. Davies新剧《Tip Toe》在美国Starz落地，他公开感谢平台敢于在特朗普政府下发行LGBTQ内容，这一表态为美英影视政治光谱差异提供了新的切口。整体来看，欧美头部IP与名人私域仍牢牢掌控流量，但政治表态的张力正在加深。

日韩.zh: KPOP在Billboard榜单与国际流媒体上继续刷新记录：Jennie与Tame Impala合作的《Dracula》打入Radio Songs Top 3，是BLACKPINK成员在主流电台的突破性成绩（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1852266wpp/jennie-breaks-top-3-of-billboard-radio-songs-chart-for-1st-time-with-tame-impala-collab-dracula)）。BABYMONSTER则用《PSYCHO》达成第六支两亿MV，YG新生代女团的持续输出力验证了“怪物新人”标签的含金量（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1852274wpp/babymonsters-psycho-becomes-their-6th-mv-to-hit-200-million-views)）。韩剧市场两部新作同时起跑：SBS动作复仇剧《Agent Kim Reactivated》收视率在第四集跃升至21.6%，而同日首播的悬疑家庭剧《The Husband》则需观察下周表现（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1852249wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-ratings-soar-past-20-percent-as-the-husband-premieres)）。此外，少女时代Yuri和RESCENE分别通过《我独自生活》《全知干预视角》展示私人空间，这类“揭密型”综艺仍是圈粉利器。Soompi还发布了7月12部新剧清单，下半年韩剧竞争将异常激烈。

中国.zh: 中国娱乐圈在“独立日”当天迎来一场情绪密集的舆论风暴。谢娜因被网民怒讽“唱功差”而取消演唱会，[BBC中文](https://news.google.)将其定性为“电视明星与专业能力错位的典型事件”。几乎同时，“明星失业”话题冲上热搜（[新浪](https://news.google.)），与横店7、8月仅开拍2部古装长剧的产业数据（[世界新闻网](https://news.google.)）相互印证。此外，迪丽热巴现身引粉丝爬楼拍照（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQclZaVU5zRUFPU3B3amNXWHRFWlg5RURKY0pwOXRYSFRINjRxbFJIMWtsS0dURk5zS280eFVsbEN5STdERm5Nd1NfMER0Yl93Tk5ZdTY4SW9OY2h4aVM5MmgwV2JZVjNMY2RMZFBXMHp2VmFpNGJfYjE2ZXpVckZsaGpaUFZCSTZVTTVEZG5DSlR1bm1lY1g4UEV4UGpib000Z2hMcmFtY0g)），时代少年团刘耀文亮相活动，以及香港影视流行音乐会贵阳演出等，显示线下活动仍在有序恢复，但“内容质量”和“观众信任”正成为行业焦点。

微博社区动态.zh: 微博热搜在昨日被四个话题主导：一是迪丽热巴“高跟鞋驾驶证”的趣味梗（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1jTVcxdXlRNVg2VHRaR1VRdUp3eWp1LTVPNzBZMVBkQzhKN0g0am1fclJQYTBLRFM5b0h0UVNnUWdBVV91S1cyZmVfTk10NzJTdDNZY0Z2V19BRGtTbl8talFhQnpfelQxUW9wOW5DcFA)），网友集体玩梗“穿高跟鞋也能考驾照”，视觉反差带来轻松笑点。二是杨紫以“白玉兰视后”身份线下瘦身亮相，评价两极（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNbk5iSzJDb2dsbkRkZWJzZGtBdUdGN3pNOFZEMkJoRV9TTUM1ak1laTFQTUdEVkJOV3NLeHB5NWhES19fYzdUOExsMml4bXpPVDcybi1MTlBJQ3Z6VXFwcklteFMzSWNDcDBHeEgwaURyak5yTGNJNGJxRjZvaU5XWVU0bk5UMmdLaGpSSUF0LXJIMlViZm91cGUtdEFXbzB2Mk9lanNwRkJVb2Z2NXgzQQ)），部分粉丝认为“瘦得太多显憔悴”，另一方则认为“敬业管理身材”。三是宋亚轩在国外被认出（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5nc3R6QUJpQXk5Y1NGSEVSWW5GY1NvdVZKcVd4dVpjTXFsUUJHWlE0ODNCWTdXSlRWSlRiY21UczItVS03SjRKOGdnalloMWV6WlpVUDdKN3lEWU5MbUhRRkRfdzJpc0tLNEFndDYyRmQ)）及红色行李箱回国路透（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFBVTGpodWY5cFVIWHpaUHNzdGNma1l5eDBkcUwtRHlNNjNQMmRyUkd0RG1RSzdJbXVOTEVGUmpzYmhMSkNrZHhoa2ROWlZZa2tXRERuMVV5QktFWWE5UVlXRkduUG5vQkJzNjh0UmJrSGM)），展现了新生代男艺人在海外累积的认知度。四是《没想到你是这样的何老师》花絮，何炅穿女士内衣搞笑片段被解读为“打工人被迫营业”的辛酸投射，话题底层情绪是共情（[360娱乐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE0zZnVFUnZwdWRESkJMLUVnTk9oYkw3Ui04UGtuVzJ3dEluU1NyQS1saXdvWTUxRnZhZzAxUDJXLTBzbDViYmJVVzdnc01pZW9hRzBQZk92M1JZR0k4OEEtWUYtMFBNYWZMdmZGZWJ2RnVjUQ)）。此外，宋雨琦“睡觉浪费时间”言论也引发讨论。微博社区整体呈现“轻松梗+严肃话题”并行的特点，但热度最高的仍是能从个体出发引发集体共鸣的内容。
